name: LDO Orbiter v2.0
description: The LDO Orbiter v2.0 is a compact, lightweight direct drive extruder featuring a planetary gear system with a 7.5:1 reduction ratio. It ships with an integrated NEMA14 36mm pancake stepper motor and dual drive gears for reliable filament grip. Its low weight and small footprint make it a popular choice for high-speed Voron-style printers.
features: Planetary gear reduction for smooth torque delivery
Compatible with many Voron toolhead designs
